title: 481. Trapping Rain Water II

examples.explanation: The central dip holds 4 units when water settles against the lowest rim.
The bowl interior traps 10 units below its rim of 3s.
A flat rim with no dip traps nothing.

hints: Think of water leaking out through the border: the lowest rim cell decides the level.
Push every border cell into a min-heap and expand inward, always popping the lowest boundary first.
When stepping to an inner cell, add max(0, boundary - its height) and push it back with the raised level.
